actual_capital.secondary_phrase_context: Recent Evernorth coverage says actual capital raised depends on warrants exercised.
actual_capital.primary_reconciliation: SEC disclosures distinguish advance-funding subscription cash, in-kind XRP contributions, debt, undrawn equity-facility capacity and potential warrant proceeds. The maximum facility/warrant amounts are not actual cash received; warrant proceeds require exercise and facility proceeds require completed sales.
actual_capital.model_note: Do not count undrawn facility capacity, unexercised warrants or in-kind XRP contributions as new open-market XRP purchases.

claim_reconciliation.claimant: Dr. Kamilah Stevenson in the June 11, 2026 XRP Podcast interview; also reported by secondary outlets citing Nikkei.
claim_reconciliation.claim: A three-month SBI Shinsei pilot beginning June 10, 2026 gives depositors crypto vouchers equal to 20% of earned interest, redeemable for BTC, ETH or XRP through SBI VC Trade; a permanent autumn 2026 rollout was contemplated.
claim_reconciliation.source_independence: These outlets repeat the same Nikkei report; they are not four independent primary confirmations.

official_related_but_distinct_programs.publisher: SBI VC Trade / SBI Shinsei Bank
official_related_but_distinct_programs.terms: Six-month yen fixed-term deposit at 0.70% pre-tax plus XRP exchange vouchers tiered by deposit principal, up to ¥20,000; this is not the reported 20%-of-interest pilot.
Deposit-tier voucher amounts from ¥500 to ¥20,000; redemption application deadline June 30, 2026; XRP credit scheduled by July 2026.
SBI Hyper Deposit balance exceeded ¥200 billion two weeks after launch; the announcement cites an XRP voucher campaign as one promotion, not the June 2026 interest pilot.

capital_and_demand_interpretation: Deposits remain yen-denominated under the secondary report; the crypto voucher is a fraction of earned interest, not 20% of principal.
A voucher is not an XRP market purchase until the customer selects XRP and redeems it through SBI VC Trade.
No aggregate pilot participation, voucher redemption, XRP units delivered, market sourcing or exchange net-flow data were found.
The reported 4.33 million eligible accounts are not 4.33 million participants or buyers.
The autumn permanent rollout and pilot outcome remain unverified as of 2026-11-05.
claim_reconciliation.example_consistency: Secondary examples vary and are not supported by published official rate/eligibility tables. Do not calculate aggregate XRP demand from them.

claim_reconciliation.claim: Japan approved reclassifying XRP and roughly 100 other crypto assets as financial instruments.

primary_timeline.event: House of Representatives approved the bill

claim_reconciliation.statutory_detail: The enacted law amends the general legal framework for crypto-asset trading and related activities. unsupported_parts: The statute does not approve XRP individually.

Enactment is not the same as the entire new regime already being in force.

claim_reconciliation.claimant: Public commentary attributed to Kamilah Stevenson; a secondary article summarizes a claim of 50x faster and 60% cheaper results from a Tokyo conference.

primary_counterevidence.details: Tokenized deposits and deposit-backed digital money conceptually evaluated using MoneyTap and an SBI Ripple Asia token-issuance platform, with XRPL assumed as the blockchain. No live XRP-vs-SWIFT bank test or measured 50x/60% result disclosed.
Japan-Korea remittance/payment research; official notice explicitly says it is not aimed at a specific service development or commercialization.

primary_counterevidence.source: SBI Group / SBI Remit / SBI VC Trade / SBI Ripple Asia
primary_counterevidence.details: SBI Remit announced XRP-bridge international remittances to bank accounts in the Philippines, Vietnam and Indonesia. This is real XRP use in specified corridors, but the notice does not publish a SWIFT comparison or 50x/60% metrics.

claim_reconciliation.conclusion: SBI has genuine XRP-linked remittance activity and separate XRPL research/POCs. That does not verify the specific live bank-versus-SWIFT performance claim.

claim_reconciliation.claimant: Public commentary attributed to Kamilah Stevenson.

primary_protocol_facts.fact: Each XRPL transaction destroys a small XRP fee; the standard minimum is typically 10 drops.
Cross-currency paths can auto-bridge through XRP when cheaper, but direct token-to-token paths may be used when better.
RLUSD launched on Coinbase across XRPL, Base and Ethereum; RLUSD on non-XRPL networks does not require XRP for those networks' transaction fees.

claim_reconciliation.interpretation: RLUSD on XRPL mechanically requires XRP for network fees, and may use XRP as a bridge where routing economics favor it. Neither fact proves material net XRP spot demand. Transaction-level bridge volume, fee burn, inventory and liquidity data are required.

joint_venture.source_note: SBI Group page states 60% voting rights; SBI presentation states SBI 60% / Ripple 40%.

historical_ripple_investment.latest_percentage_found: approximately 9% based on actual holdings in SBI's 2025-02-07 presentation

research_and_poc.status: research only; not a specific service development or commercialization
conceptual proof of concept for tokenized deposits/deposit-backed digital money; XRPL assumed; not evidence of live XRP bridge demand

rlusd_distribution.status: official RLUSD listing as a Type 4 electronic payment instrument in Japan; direct SBI/Ripple collaboration; not evidence of XRP purchases.

coinbase_ripple.status: RLUSD distribution across Coinbase Prime, Exchange and Retail on XRPL, Base and Ethereum; Coinbase Global Exchange collateral support was described as future availability at launch.

circle_ripple.note: Circle issues USDC; Ripple issues RLUSD. BNY is a shared institutional custody/reserve-services node, not proof of a direct Circle-Ripple partnership.
